name: Potion of Fire Breath

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: For 1 hour, a Bonus Action breath of fire at a creature within 30 ft (Dex DC 13, 4d6 Fire, half on a success), three times.
text: After drinking this potion, you can take a Bonus Action to exhale fire at a target within 30 feet of you. The target makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much on a success. The effect ends after you exhale the fire three times or when 1 hour has passed. The orange liquid flickers, and smoke fills the top of the container and wafts out whenever it's opened.
